messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have any of these signs of an allergic reaction to carvedilol: hives; difficulty breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have a serious side effect such as:
- a light-headed feeling, like you might pass out;
- slow or uneven heartbeats;
- swelling, rapid weight gain, feeling short of breath (even with mild exertion);
- cold feeling or numbness in your fingers or toes;
- chest pain, dry cough, wheezing, chest tightness, trouble breathing; or
- high blood sugar (increased thirst, increased urination, hunger, dry mouth, fruity breath odor, drowsiness, dry skin, blurred vision, weight loss).
Common carvedilol side effects may include:
- weakness, dizziness;
- diarrhea;
- dry eyes;
- tired feeling; or
- weight gain.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["carvedilol", "has allergic reaction sign", "hives"]

The relation 'has allergic reaction sign' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may cause the specific symptom specified by the object entity as a sign of an allergic reaction.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'mimics symptoms of': The subject condition or drug may present symptoms that resemble those of the medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'can occur with': The subject drug can be present in individuals who also have the condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
